CLASSIFICATION: correctly recorded as a gas transmission trunk (not a gathering/feeder line) -- KPMG groups it with the other 14 named main transmission trunks, all 1.2-1.4m diameter, 5.5-7.5 MPa pressure-class lines. DUPLICATE CHECK against the roster's 'Izmail corridor' / 'Ananiiv hub' clusters flagged in the scope guidance: en.wikipedia.org's 'Natural gas in Ukraine' article states outright (citing a 2012 Ministry of Energy/Energy Community filing) that 'Main pipelines of the southern transit corridor are the Yelets-Kremenchuk-Kryvyi Rih pipeline [P0783], the Shebelinka-Dnipropetrovsk-Kryvyi Rih-Rozdilna-Izmail pipeline [P0784], the Kremenchuk-Ananyiv-Bohorodchany pipeline [P1485], the Ananyiv-Tiraspol-Izmail pipeline [THIS ROW, P0786], and the Rozdilna-Izmail pipeline [P0787]' -- five distinct, separately named physical trunks, matching the roster 1:1 by name. So P0786 is not a relabel or segment double-count of P0783/P0784/P1485/P0787 -- it is the one line in the cluster with a genuinely different (cross-border-via-Moldova) routing, confirmed by two independent primary corridor-planning documents plus a tertiary cross-check. Not independently re-verified: the Wikipedia claim is itself useful corroboration but I treat the two primary documents (Naftogaz Master Plan 2009 + KPMG 2017) as the load-bearing sources.

resolutions.researcher_notes: P3381 and P3382 share the identical pipeline name in the sheet ('Shebelinka–Slovyansk Gas Pipeline') and are clearly the same named corridor, but the tsoua.com official project description resolves WHY the two rows carry different length/diameter rather than being a pure duplicate: TSOUA's own investment-project page describes replacing the original Du700 pipe with a NEW Du500 pipe laid PARALLEL to the existing route ('заміна труби Ду 700 ... на трубу Ду 500 ... шляхом прокладки паралельно існуючий трасі'), in sections UT-1 (km1.1-13.6), UT-2 (km13.6-26.1), UT-3 (km26.1-39.9) and UT-4 (km39.9-55.1) — and explicitly states the plan is to DISMANTLE the old Du700 pipe only AFTER the Du500 section is commissioned ('демонтування існуючого газопроводу ДУ 700 після прийняття в експлуатацію ділянки Ду 500'). Doing the arithmetic on the UT sections: (13.6-1.1)+(26.1-13.6)+(39.9-26.1)+(55.1-39.9) = 12.5+12.5+13.8+15.2 = 54.0 km — an EXACT match to P3382's LengthKnown=54.0 and DiameterUnits=500mm. This is too precise to be coincidence: P3382 is almost certainly GEM's entry for the new/parallel Du500 pipe covering exactly the UT-1–UT-4 corridor (km1.1–55.1), while P3381 (this row, 70km, Du700, built 1969) is the ORIGINAL full-corridor pipe. So the pair likely represents two related-but-distinct physical assets mid-transition (old full-length line + new partial-length parallel replacement under construction), analogous to the Ivatsevichy-Kobryn-Dolyna I/II pattern rather than a straightforward double-count — BUT there is real double-count risk if/once the Du500 section is fully commissioned and the Du700 section over that same 54km stretch is formally dismantled per TSOUA's own stated plan: at that point P3381's full 70km would overlap the now-decommissioned middle of the corridor with P3382's 54km of live pipe, and P3381's Status/Length would need updating to reflect only the still-operating Du700 remainder (roughly km0-1.1 and km55.1-68.6/70, i.e. ~14-16km) rather than the full 70km. I could not verify whether the Du700 dismantling has actually happened as of 2026 (see spec/status caveat below) — leaving that determination, and the merge/no-merge call, to the cluster adjudication pass.

Separately, as a rough sanity check (not itself a citation): great-circle distance from Ivatsevichi, Belarus (~52.71N 25.34E) to Dolyna, Ukraine (~48.97N 23.98E) is roughly 425-430 km, which is hard to reconcile with EITHER 146 km or 292 km for a single continuous asset spanning that distance -- worth a routing/endpoint sanity check alongside the capacity/length fix, though I could not independently confirm the true route length and am not proposing a specific corrected number. I have not filled Capacity or Length with the current values' refs, since the sources I found do not actually support 29 bcm/y / 292 km as per-thread figures -- filling them would misrepresent what the sources say.
